terms.name: u
terms.definition: 0 when not urgent; when urgent, 1 for inner, 2 for middle, 3 for outer if tail reference is known, otherwise 3

terms.name: tau
terms.definition: min(900, landing_end - snapshot.time) when landed; min(900, HORIZON + ref.duration) when known partial tail; 901 + remaining_lower(snapshot, ring) when unknown

objective.solver_coefficients: (int(f), int(l), int(u), int(round(tau*10)), int(round(joules/3600))); l is the second objective component -landing

hint.construction: EnergySlackScheduler().plan(snapshot, candidates, context, budget, validation_reserve_seconds=budget.hint_validation_reserve_seconds) inside hint_construction and HINT_BUDGET stage limit.
hint.incumbent_initialization: incumbent = hint if hint.certified else None

model_and_scoring.exact_one: one BoolVar per candidate column with AddExactlyOne per aircraft
model_and_scoring.hint_application: AddHint(v, int(key in chosen)) for each model variable when a certified incumbent exists
model_and_scoring.phase_scoring: for phase, expression is sum(solver_coefficients(column)[phase] * variable); model.Minimize(expression); after certified feasible validation, model.Add(expression == rounded solver objective)

selected_verification.prefix: check_commit_prefix(selected) only when batch result is accepted and watchdog is available

cuts.pair: explicit two-column conflicts add sorted signature pair exclusions
cuts.single: explicit one-column conflicts add single-column exclusions
cuts.prefix_nogood: accepted batch with rejected committed prefix adds the selected signature tuple
cuts.unknown: UNKNOWN batch or prefix validation stops refinement and does not add cuts

final_incumbent.update: verified proposal replaces incumbent only when proposal.objective < incumbent.objective
final_incumbent.fallback: if no incumbent exists, KEEP columns are checked and recorded as NO_VERIFIED_INCUMBENT
final_incumbent.completion_check: CATALOG_LEX_OPTIMAL requires all_optimal, resource_complete, model_complete, final phase 4 OPTIMAL and solver-key equality; otherwise LEX_LIMITED

candidate_and_commit_counts.candidate_count_field_definition: full_normal_chain_count is the count of MOVE columns whose last plan has pad_id != null; this is the recorded predicted_landing_columns alias.

v6_planning_summary.cut_count_scope: Logged cumulative counters include initial resource cuts; maxima are taken once per call/restart, then summed.
v6_planning_summary.unknown_cut_proof_in_run_logs: UNKNOWN: absent cumulative counters cannot establish a zero-cut proof

final_normal_landing_set_comparison.definition: normal landed ID = touchdown event with details.emergency === false in the method's replay_0480/events.jsonl

covers: final objective equals selected objective and is below hint objective
UNKNOWN validation does not become a cut
complete and partial MOVE chain retention
UNKNOWN leaves pair/single/prefix cuts at zero
